message: How could Rohin’s reported C2 example—comparing predictions with a calculated k=3 case, then revising its judgment—help you turn your multiplication menu into your own attempt? Would further thought settle your changing expression, or would a small attempt provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step do you choose next, and what will you do differently instead of asking your reader to decide? What observation would change that choice? What finding, evidence source, uncertainty, and unfinished step will you carry forward?
